svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 19 / WHACK-A-MOLE
svg.desc: 17,069 GitHub contributions across 152 active days, 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-28. One mole appears on every actual active date at its original week and weekday coordinates, with lower counts first. Higher contribution counts shorten the pop window, while real daily streaks reduce hammer reaction time. The hammer travels to that date and banks its contributions only before the mole hides. Zero-count date tiles stay visible, and missing dates are absent.

g.text: WHACK A DATE / LOW COUNTS FIRST
WHACK A DATE / LOW COUNTS FIRST
Each mole appears on its own original date tile.
